description: Application for Reserved Matters Approval for layout, scale, design, appearance, access and landscaping pursuant to Condition 5 of the Pudding Mill Lane Outline Planning Permission (ref:  21/00574/OUT) comprising the construction of Development Parcels J, K and L, accommodating residential units (Use Class C3) with supporting commercial, business and service floorspace (Use Class E(a-c), health centre and pharmacy (Use Class E(e)), nursery (Use Class E(f)), realignment of Marshgate Lane, associated blue badge parking and cycle parking, the provision of play space, public realm, landscape access and associated works.

phasing_details.phase_detail: Phase 1 is to be completed in its entirety. Future phases will come forward at later dates.
